findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "resend_fax" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this only after the person asks to resend a failed fax and confirms its destination, including any corrected number. Check get_fax or get_fax_status first. …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: open_fax_review, get_fax_review, get_fax_report, create_fax, get_account, get_organizations, get_inbound_fax · Private data: open_fax_review, get_capabilities, get_fax_report, create_document, create_fax, get_fax, send_fax, get_organizations, get_inbound_fax · Public sink: open_fax_review, prepare_fax_upload, create_fax, get_account, send_fax.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: open_fax_review, get_fax_review, get_fax_report, create_fax, get_account, get_organizations, get_inbound_fax · Private data: open_fax_review, get_capabilities, get_fax_report, create_document, create_fax, get_fax, send_fax, get_organizations, get_inbound_fax · Public sink: open_fax_review, prepare_fax_upload, create_fax, get_account, send_fax

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_capabilities" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
